content.text:
Finding submitted.

**MFN — deviation (Article XXII, ¶¶ p0139–p0141).** Pricing (Article V tiers, Supplemental Payments, rebate shares) carries no best-price or best-terms undertaking by us, so the fee mechanics are clean. The responsive burden is the Licensor's Right of First Refusal: we must notify Licensor of any bona fide third-party offer for our assets or control and give Licensor five business days to take that transaction on the same terms — a right-to-match/most-favoured-offer mechanic in Vendor's favour, unlimited as to subject matter, running for the whole term, with no like-for-like comparison carve-outs. It fails all three fallback elements, so we redlined to the preferred position by striking the mechanic and conforming the surviving sentence ("The Licensee shall have the right to consummate the transaction with the third party.") so no orphan reference to the deleted "Right of First Refusal" or "Exercise Period" remains.
